string[] lines(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    rows := content.split(NL)
    return rows[0:<int(#rows) - 1]

class Generator(int state)
    int .draw()
        state = (48271 * state) % 2147483647
        return state

    void .shuffle(int[] &values)
        count := int(#values)
        while count >= 2
            j := .draw() % count
            temporary := values[count - 1]
            values[count - 1] = values[j]
            values[j] = temporary
            count -= 1

class Image(string id, int label, string pixels, real64[] vector)
class Architecture(string name, int[] units, string[] activations, real64[] initial)
class Run(string name, string network_name, string optimizer, real64 rate, real64 decay, real64[] extra)
class Params(int seed, int batch_size, int max_epochs, int patience, int lr_step, real64 lr_gamma, int gradient_stride, int calibration_bins, int[] prune, int[] noise, Run[] runs)
class Input(int width, int height, Image[] training, Image[] testing, Architecture[] architectures, Params params)

Image[] read_images(string name)
    rows := lines("input/" + name)
    Image[] result := []
    for row := rows[1:<int(#rows)][]
        fields := row.split(",")
        pixels := fields[2]
        real64[] vector := [for i := (0:<int(#pixels))[] then (if pixels[i] == "1" then 1.0 else 0.0)]
        result = result.append(Image(fields[0], integer(fields[1]), pixels, vector))
    return result

Params read_settings()
    seed := 0
    batch_size := 0
    max_epochs := 0
    patience := 0
    lr_step := 0
    real64 lr_gamma := 0.0
    gradient_stride := 0
    calibration_bins := 0
    int[] prune := []
    int[] noise := []
    Run[] runs := []
    for row := lines("input/params.txt")[]
        fields := row.split(" ")
        key := fields[0]
        if key == "SEED"
            seed = integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "BATCH_SIZE"
            batch_size = integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "MAX_EPOCHS"
            max_epochs = integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "PATIENCE"
            patience = integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "LR_STEP"
            lr_step = integer(fields[1])
            lr_gamma = number(fields[2])
        elif key == "GRADIENT_CHECK_STRIDE"
            gradient_stride = integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "CALIBRATION_BINS"
            calibration_bins = integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "PRUNE"
            prune = [for text := fields[1:<int(#fields)][] then integer(text)]
        elif key == "NOISE"
            noise = [for text := fields[1:<int(#fields)][] then integer(text)]
        else
            extra := [for text := fields[6:<int(#fields)][] then number(text)]
            runs = runs.append(Run(fields[1], fields[2], fields[3], number(fields[4]), number(fields[5]), extra))
    return Params(seed, batch_size, max_epochs, patience, lr_step, lr_gamma, gradient_stride, calibration_bins, prune, noise, runs)

Input read_inputs()
    rows := lines("input/network.txt")
    dimensions := rows[0].split(" ")
    Architecture[] architectures := []
    for row := rows[2:<int(#rows)][]
        if row != ""
            fields := row.split(" ")
            if fields[0] == "NETWORK"
                architectures = architectures.append(Architecture(fields[1], [], [], []))
            else
                index := int(#architectures) - 1
                architectures[index].units = architectures[index].units.append(integer(fields[1]))
                architectures[index].activations = architectures[index].activations.append(fields[2])
    current := -1
    for row := lines("input/weights.txt")[]
        if row != ""
            fields := row.split(" ")
            if fields[0] == "NETWORK"
                current += 1
            elif fields[0] == "W" or fields[0] == "B"
                architectures[current].initial = architectures[current].initial.concat([for text := fields[1:<int(#fields)][] then number(text)])
    return Input(integer(dimensions[1]), integer(dimensions[2]), read_images("train.csv"), read_images("test.csv"), architectures, read_settings())

import math

string padded(int value, int width)
    text := string(value)
    return "0" * nat(width - int(#text)) + text

string real_text(real64 value, int places)
    factor := 10 ^ places
    magnitude := if value < 0.0 then -value else value
    rounded := math.floor(magnitude * real64(factor) + 0.5)
    sign_text := if value < 0.0 and rounded != 0 then "-" else ""
    return sign_text + string(rounded / factor) + "." + padded(rounded % factor, places)

string ratio(int numerator, int denominator)
    if denominator == 0
        return "-"
    rounded := (20000 * numerator + denominator) / (2 * denominator)
    return string(rounded / 10000) + "." + padded(rounded % 10000, 4)

int[] best_two(real64[] scores)
    first := 0
    for: i < int(#scores)
        if scores[i] > scores[first]
            first = i
    second := if first == 0 then 1 else 0
    for: i < int(#scores)
        if i != first and scores[i] > scores[second]
            second = i
    return [first, second]

int[][] confusion(int[] labels, int[] predictions, int classes)
    table := [for k := (0:<int(classes))[] then [for j := (0:<int(classes))[] then 0]]
    for: i < int(#labels)
        table[labels[i]][predictions[i]] += 1
    return table

class Measures(int support, int predicted, string precision, string recall, string f1)

Measures class_measures(int[][] table, int klass)
    support := 0
    predicted := 0
    for: i < int(#table)
        support += table[klass][i]
        predicted += table[i][klass]
    correct := table[klass][klass]
    return Measures(support, predicted, ratio(correct, predicted), ratio(correct, support), ratio(2 * correct, support + predicted))

string[] level_maps(int[][] levels, int width, int height)
    string[] rows := []
    for: row < height
        string[] maps := []
        for level := levels[]
            maps = maps.append([for column := (0:<int(width))[] then string(level[row * width + column])].join(""))
        rows = rows.append(maps.join(" "))
    return rows

string[] ascii_image(string pixels, int width)
    string[] rows := []
    for: 0 <= first < int(#pixels) step width
        rows = rows.append([for i := (0:<int(width))[] then (if pixels[first + i] == "1" then "#" else ".")].join(""))
    return rows

import math

real64 hidden_activation(string kind, real64 value)
    if kind == "TANH"
        return 1.0 - 2.0 / (math.exp(2.0 * value) + 1.0)
    if kind == "SIGMOID"
        return 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-value))
    return if value > 0.0 then value else 0.0

real64 hidden_derivative(string kind, real64 z, real64 activated)
    if kind == "TANH"
        return 1.0 - activated * activated
    if kind == "SIGMOID"
        return activated * (1.0 - activated)
    return if z > 0.0 then 1.0 else 0.0

real64[] pre_activation(real64[][] weights, real64[] biases, real64[] activation)
    real64[] result := []
    for: j < int(#weights)
        real64 weighted := 0.0
        for: i < int(#activation)
            weighted += weights[j][i] * activation[i]
        result = result.append(weighted + biases[j])
    return result

real64[] backward_sum(real64[][] weights, real64[] output_error)
    real64[] result := []
    for: column < int(#weights[0])
        real64 value := 0.0
        for: row < int(#weights)
            value += weights[row][column] * output_error[row]
        result = result.append(value)
    return result

class Output(real64[] scores, real64 loss, real64[] delta)

Output output_scores(string kind, real64[] z, int label)
    count := int(#z)
    real64[] scores := []
    real64[] delta := []
    real64 loss := 0.0
    if kind == "SOFTMAX"
        maximum := z[0]
        for value := z[]
            if value > maximum
                maximum = value
        real64[] terms := [for value := z[] then math.exp(value - maximum)]
        real64 total := 0.0
        for value := terms[]
            total += value
        scores = [for value := terms[] then value / total]
        logarithm := math.log(total)
        loss = logarithm - (z[label] - maximum)
        delta = [for k := (0:<int(count))[] then scores[k] - (if k == label then 1.0 else 0.0)]
    else
        scores = [for value := z[] then 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-value))]
        for: k < count
            real64 residual := scores[k] - (if k == label then 1.0 else 0.0)
            loss += residual * residual
            delta = delta.append(2.0 * residual * scores[k] * (1.0 - scores[k]) / real64(count))
        loss /= real64(count)
    return Output(scores, loss, delta)

import math
import dataset = "./dataset.qui"
import network = "./network.qui"
import optimizers = "./optimizers.qui"
import evaluation = "./evaluation.qui"

int minimum(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then first else second

int integer_maximum(int first, int second)
    return if first > second then first else second

real64 maximum(real64 first, real64 second)
    return if first > second then first else second

real64 absolute(real64 value)
    return if value < 0.0 then -value else value

string words(int[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then string(value)].join(" ")

string real_words(real64[] values, places := 4)
    return [for value := values[] then evaluation.real_text(value, places)].join(" ")

string yes(bool value)
    return if value then "yes" else "no"

real64 norm(real64[] values)
    real64 total := 0.0
    for value := values[]
        total += value * value
    result := math.sqrt(total)
    return result

real64 mean(real64[] values)
    real64 total := 0.0
    for value := values[]
        total += value
    return total / real64(#values)

real64[][] image_vectors(dataset.Image[] images)
    return [for image := images[] then image.vector]

int[] image_labels(dataset.Image[] images)
    return [for image := images[] then image.label]

class Net(string name, network.Layout layout, real64[] initial)

Net[] build_catalog(dataset.Input data)
    return [for architecture := data.architectures[] then Net(architecture.name, network.layout_for(data.width * data.height, architecture.units, architecture.activations), architecture.initial)]

class Outcome(int label, int predicted, real64 confidence, real64[] scores, real64 loss, real64[][] hidden)
class Evaluated(real64 loss, int correct, Outcome[] outcomes)

Evaluated evaluate(Net net, real64[] theta, dataset.Image[] images)
    real64 total := 0.0
    correct := 0
    Outcome[] outcomes := []
    for image := images[]
        cache := network.forward(net.layout, theta, image.vector, image.label)
        prediction := evaluation.best_two(cache.scores)[0]
        if prediction == image.label
            correct += 1
        total += cache.loss
        outcomes = outcomes.append(Outcome(image.label, prediction, cache.scores[prediction], cache.scores, cache.loss, cache.a[1:<int(#cache.a) - 1]))
    return Evaluated(total / real64(#images), correct, outcomes)

string[] check_network(Net net, dataset.Image[] training, dataset.Params params)
    generator := dataset.Generator(params.seed)
    sequence := [for i := (0:<int(#training))[] then i]
    .generator.shuffle(&sequence)
    batch := [for i := sequence[0:<minimum(params.batch_size, int(#training))][] then training[i]]
    theta := net.initial
    analytic := network.average_gradient(net.layout, theta, image_vectors(batch), image_labels(batch))
    checked := 0
    passed := true
    real64 h := 0.00001
    for: 0 <= index < net.layout.parameters step params.gradient_stride
        original := theta[index]
        theta[index] = original + h
        higher := evaluate(net, theta, batch)
        theta[index] = original - h
        lower := evaluate(net, theta, batch)
        theta[index] = original
        derivative := (higher.loss - lower.loss) / (2.0 * h)
        relative_error := absolute(analytic.values[index] - derivative) / maximum(1.0, absolute(analytic.values[index]) + absolute(derivative))
        if relative_error >= 0.000001
            passed = false
        checked += 1
    lines := ["network {net.name}", "parameters {net.layout.parameters}", "batch " + [for image := batch[] then image.id].join(" ")]
    for: l < int(#net.layout.levels)
        network.Layer level := net.layout.levels[l]
        weights := 0
        biases := 0
        for: level.weight_start <= p < level.weight_end
            if p % params.gradient_stride == 0
                weights += 1
        for: level.bias_start <= p < level.bias_end
            if p % params.gradient_stride == 0
                biases += 1
        lines = lines.append("layer {l + 1} weights {weights} biases {biases}")
    return lines.concat(["checked {checked}", "result " + (if passed then "PASS" else "FAIL")])

class Epoch(int number, real64 rate, real64 gradient_norm, real64 train_loss, int train_correct, real64 val_loss, int val_correct, bool improved)
class Bin(int count, int correct, real64 confidence)
class Hidden(real64[][] means, int[] preferred, int[] zero_counts)
class Pruning(int percent, int removed, int correct, real64 loss)
class Noise(int percent, int flipped, int correct)
class Trained(dataset.Run definition, Net net)
    real64[] best_theta := []
    best_epoch := 0
    real64 best_loss := 0.0
    best_correct := 0
    Epoch[] epochs := []
    updates := 0
    stop := "max_epochs"
    bool[][] correctness := []
    testing := Evaluated(0.0, 0, [])
    int[][] confusion := []
    top2 := 0
    confidence_correct := "-"
    confidence_wrong := "-"
    forgetting := [0, 0, 0]
    real64[] weight_norms := []
    real64[] weight_changes := []
    Bin[] calibration := []
    real64 ece := 0.0
    Hidden[] hidden_summary := []
    Pruning[] pruning := []
    Noise[] noise_results := []
    int[] misclassified := []

Trained train_run(dataset.Run definition, Net net, dataset.Image[] training, dataset.Image[] validation, dataset.Params params)
    result := Trained(definition, net)
    theta := net.initial
    optimizer_state := optimizers.State(definition.optimizer, definition.extra, net.layout.parameters)
    generator := dataset.Generator(params.seed)
    order := [for i := (0:<int(#training))[] then i]
    wait := 0
    for: 1 <= epoch <= params.max_epochs
        rate := optimizers.epoch_rate(definition.rate, epoch, params.lr_step, params.lr_gamma)
        .generator.shuffle(&order)
        real64[] gradient_norms := []
        for: 0 <= first < int(#order) step params.batch_size
            last := minimum(int(#order), first + params.batch_size)
            batch := [for i := order[first:<last][] then training[i]]
            average := network.average_gradient(net.layout, theta, image_vectors(batch), image_labels(batch))
            gradient := average.values
            for: p < net.layout.parameters
                if net.layout.is_weight[p]
                    gradient[p] += definition.decay * theta[p]
            gradient_norms = gradient_norms.append(norm(gradient))
            optimizers.update(&theta, gradient, &optimizer_state, rate)
            result.updates += 1
        train_result := evaluate(net, theta, training)
        validation_result := evaluate(net, theta, validation)
        result.correctness = result.correctness.append([for outcome := train_result.outcomes[] then outcome.predicted == outcome.label])
        improved := epoch == 1 or validation_result.loss < result.best_loss
        if improved
            result.best_epoch = epoch
            result.best_loss = validation_result.loss
            result.best_correct = validation_result.correct
            result.best_theta = theta
            wait = 0
        else
            wait += 1
        result.epochs = result.epochs.append(Epoch(epoch, rate, mean(gradient_norms), train_result.loss, train_result.correct, validation_result.loss, validation_result.correct, improved))
        if wait >= params.patience
            result.stop = "early"
            break
    return result

class Noisy(dataset.Image[] images, int flipped)

Noisy noisy_images(dataset.Image[] images, int percent, int seed)
    generator := dataset.Generator(seed)
    dataset.Image[] altered := []
    flipped := 0
    for image := images[]
        vector := image.vector
        string[] pixels := []
        for: p < int(#vector)
            if .generator.draw() % 100 < percent
                vector[p] = 1.0 - vector[p]
                flipped += 1
            pixels = pixels.append(if vector[p] == 1.0 then "1" else "0")
        altered = altered.append(dataset.Image(image.id, image.label, pixels.join(""), vector))
    return Noisy(altered, flipped)

int[] ordered_weights(real64[] theta, bool[] is_weight)
    int[] result := []
    for: p < int(#theta)
        if is_weight[p]
            position := int(#result)
            for: i < int(#result)
                if absolute(theta[p]) < absolute(theta[result[i]])
                    position = i
                    break
            result = result[0:<position].concat([p]).concat(result[position:<int(#result)])
    return result

void prepare_evaluation(Trained &result, dataset.Image[] training, dataset.Image[] testing, dataset.Params params)
    net := result.net
    theta := result.best_theta
    int classes := net.layout.levels[-1].outputs
    result.testing = evaluate(net, theta, testing)
    Outcome[] outcomes := result.testing.outcomes
    result.confusion = evaluation.confusion(image_labels(testing), [for outcome := outcomes[] then outcome.predicted], classes)
    real64[] correct_confidence := []
    real64[] wrong_confidence := []
    for: i < int(#outcomes)
        outcome := outcomes[i]
        best := evaluation.best_two(outcome.scores)
        if outcome.label == best[0] or outcome.label == best[1]
            result.top2 += 1
        if outcome.predicted == outcome.label
            correct_confidence = correct_confidence.append(outcome.confidence)
        else
            wrong_confidence = wrong_confidence.append(outcome.confidence)
            result.misclassified = result.misclassified.append(i)
    if #correct_confidence > 0
        result.confidence_correct = evaluation.real_text(mean(correct_confidence), 4)
    if #wrong_confidence > 0
        result.confidence_wrong = evaluation.real_text(mean(wrong_confidence), 4)
    for: i < int(#training)
        events := 0
        learned := false
        for: epoch < int(#result.correctness)
            if result.correctness[epoch][i]
                learned = true
            if epoch > 0 and result.correctness[epoch - 1][i] and not result.correctness[epoch][i]
                events += 1
        result.forgetting[0] += events
        if events > 0
            result.forgetting[1] += 1
        if not learned
            result.forgetting[2] += 1
    for level := net.layout.levels[]
        final_weights := theta[level.weight_start:<level.weight_end]
        initial := net.initial[level.weight_start:<level.weight_end]
        result.weight_norms = result.weight_norms.append(norm(final_weights))
        result.weight_changes = result.weight_changes.append(norm(final_weights - initial))
    bins := params.calibration_bins
    bin_counts := [for i := (0:<int(bins))[] then 0]
    bin_correct := [for i := (0:<int(bins))[] then 0]
    real64[] bin_totals := [for i := (0:<int(bins))[] then 0.0]
    for outcome := outcomes[]
        bin_index := math.floor(outcome.confidence * real64(bins))
        bin_index = minimum(bin_index, bins - 1)
        bin_counts[bin_index] += 1
        bin_totals[bin_index] += outcome.confidence
        if outcome.predicted == outcome.label
            bin_correct[bin_index] += 1
    for: bin_index < bins
        count := bin_counts[bin_index]
        confidence := if count > 0 then bin_totals[bin_index] / real64(count) else 0.0
        result.calibration = result.calibration.append(Bin(count, bin_correct[bin_index], confidence))
        if count > 0
            result.ece += real64(count) / real64(#testing) * absolute(real64(bin_correct[bin_index]) / real64(count) - confidence)
    for: l < int(#net.layout.levels) - 1
        network.Layer level := net.layout.levels[l]
        real64[][] means := []
        bool[] present := []
        for: klass < classes
            real64[] values := [for j := (0:<int(level.outputs))[] then 0.0]
            count := 0
            for outcome := outcomes[]
                if outcome.label == klass
                    count += 1
                    for: j < level.outputs
                        values[j] += outcome.hidden[l][j]
            present = present.append(count > 0)
            real64[] class_means := if count > 0 then [for value := values[] then value / real64(count)] else []
            means = means.append(class_means)
        int[] preferred := []
        int[] zero_counts := []
        for: j < level.outputs
            chosen := -1
            for: klass < classes
                if present[klass] and (chosen < 0 or means[klass][j] > means[chosen][j])
                    chosen = klass
            preferred = preferred.append(chosen)
            zeros := 0
            for outcome := outcomes[]
                if outcome.hidden[l][j] == 0.0
                    zeros += 1
            zero_counts = zero_counts.append(zeros)
        result.hidden_summary = result.hidden_summary.append(Hidden(means, preferred, zero_counts))
    order := ordered_weights(theta, net.layout.is_weight)
    for percent := params.prune[]
        count := percent * net.layout.weight_count / 100
        pruned := theta
        for p := order[0:<count][]
            pruned[p] = 0.0
        evaluated := evaluate(net, pruned, testing)
        result.pruning = result.pruning.append(Pruning(percent, count, evaluated.correct, evaluated.loss))
    for percent := params.noise[]
        altered := noisy_images(testing, percent, params.seed)
        evaluated := evaluate(net, theta, altered.images)
        result.noise_results = result.noise_results.append(Noise(percent, altered.flipped, evaluated.correct))

string[] gradient_check_lines(Net[] catalog, dataset.Image[] training, dataset.Params params)
    string[] lines := []
    for: i < int(#catalog)
        if i > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.concat(check_network(catalog[i], training, params))
    return lines

string[] training_log_lines(Trained[] runs, int training_count, int validation_count)
    lines := ["run,epoch,lr,grad_norm,train_loss,train_acc,val_loss,val_acc,improved"]
    for trained := runs[]
        for epoch := trained.epochs[]
            values := [trained.definition.name, string(epoch.number), evaluation.real_text(epoch.rate, 6), evaluation.real_text(epoch.gradient_norm, 4), evaluation.real_text(epoch.train_loss, 6), evaluation.ratio(epoch.train_correct, training_count), evaluation.real_text(epoch.val_loss, 6), evaluation.ratio(epoch.val_correct, validation_count), (if epoch.improved then "1" else "0")]
            lines = lines.append(values.join(","))
    return lines

string[] final_weight_lines(Trained[] runs)
    string[] lines := []
    for: i < int(#runs)
        trained := runs[i]
        if i > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.append("RUN {trained.definition.name} NETWORK {trained.net.name} EPOCH {trained.best_epoch}")
        for: l < int(#trained.net.layout.levels)
            network.Layer level := trained.net.layout.levels[l]
            lines = lines.append("LAYER {l + 1} {level.outputs} {level.inputs}")
            for: j < level.outputs
                first := level.weight_start + j * level.inputs
                lines = lines.append("W " + real_words(trained.best_theta[first:<first + level.inputs]))
            lines = lines.append("B " + real_words(trained.best_theta[level.bias_start:<level.bias_end]))
    return lines

string[] prediction_lines(Trained[] runs, dataset.Image[] testing)
    lines := ["run,id,label,predicted,confidence"]
    for trained := runs[]
        for: i < int(#testing)
            Outcome outcome := trained.testing.outcomes[i]
            lines = lines.append("{trained.definition.name},{testing[i].id},{testing[i].label},{outcome.predicted}," + evaluation.real_text(outcome.confidence, 4))
    return lines

string[] data_summary_lines(dataset.Image[] training, dataset.Image[] validation, dataset.Image[] testing, int width, int height, int classes)
    pixels := width * height
    lines := ["data", "train {#training} validation {#validation} test {#testing} pixels {pixels}"]
    int[][] maps := []
    for: klass < classes
        training_count := 0
        validation_count := 0
        test_count := 0
        ink := 0
        frequencies := [for p := (0:<int(pixels))[] then 0]
        for image := training[]
            if image.label == klass
                training_count += 1
                for: p < pixels
                    if image.pixels[p] == "1"
                        ink += 1
                        frequencies[p] += 1
        for image := validation[]
            if image.label == klass
                validation_count += 1
        for image := testing[]
            if image.label == klass
                test_count += 1
        lines = lines.append("class {klass} train {training_count} validation {validation_count} test {test_count} ink " + evaluation.ratio(ink, training_count))
        maps = maps.append([for count := frequencies[] then (if training_count == 0 then 0 else minimum(9, 10 * count / training_count))])
    lines = lines.append("mean_images " + words([for klass := (0:<int(classes))[] then klass]))
    return lines.concat(evaluation.level_maps(maps, width, height))

string[] curve_lines(Trained trained)
    real64 largest := 0.0
    for epoch := trained.epochs[]
        largest = maximum(largest, maximum(epoch.train_loss, epoch.val_loss))
    lines := ["curve"]
    for epoch := trained.epochs[]
        canvas := [for i := (0:<40)[] then " "]
        train_column := math.floor(39.0 * epoch.train_loss / largest + 0.5)
        validation_column := math.floor(39.0 * epoch.val_loss / largest + 0.5)
        canvas[train_column] = "t"
        canvas[validation_column] = if validation_column == train_column then "*" else "v"
        number := (if epoch.number < 10 then " " else "") + string(epoch.number)
        lines = lines.append(number + " |" + canvas.join("") + "|" + (if epoch.number == trained.best_epoch then " best" else ""))
    return lines

string[] confusion_lines(Trained trained)
    table := trained.confusion
    lines := ["confusion"]
    for: klass < int(#table)
        lines = lines.append("{klass}: " + words(table[klass]))
    for: klass < int(#table)
        stats := evaluation.class_measures(table, klass)
        lines = lines.append("class {klass} support {stats.support} predicted {stats.predicted} precision {stats.precision} recall {stats.recall} f1 {stats.f1}")
    return lines

string[] calibration_lines(Trained trained)
    bins := int(#trained.calibration)
    lines := ["calibration"]
    for: i < bins
        calibration_bin := trained.calibration[i]
        accuracy := if calibration_bin.count > 0 then evaluation.ratio(calibration_bin.correct, calibration_bin.count) else "-"
        confidence := if calibration_bin.count > 0 then evaluation.real_text(calibration_bin.confidence, 4) else "-"
        lines = lines.append("bin {i + 1} " + evaluation.real_text(real64(i) / real64(bins), 2) + " " + evaluation.real_text(real64(i + 1) / real64(bins), 2) + " count {calibration_bin.count} accuracy {accuracy} confidence {confidence}")
    return lines.append("ece " + evaluation.real_text(trained.ece, 4))

string[] hidden_lines(Trained trained)
    string[] lines := []
    for: l < int(#trained.hidden_summary)
        network.Layer level := trained.net.layout.levels[l]
        hidden := trained.hidden_summary[l]
        lines = lines.append("hidden {l + 1} {level.activation} units {level.outputs}")
        for: klass < int(#hidden.means)
            text := if #hidden.means[klass] == 0 then "-" else real_words(hidden.means[klass])
            lines = lines.append("class {klass} mean {text}")
        lines = lines.append("preferred " + words(hidden.preferred))
        if level.activation == "RELU"
            lines = lines.append("zero_counts " + words(hidden.zero_counts))
    return lines

string[] run_evaluation_lines(Trained trained, dataset.Image[] testing, int validation_count)
    count := int(#testing)
    int correct := trained.testing.correct
    lines := ["run {trained.definition.name} network {trained.net.name} optimizer {trained.definition.optimizer}",
        "epochs {#trained.epochs} best_epoch {trained.best_epoch} stop {trained.stop} updates {trained.updates}",
        "best_val_loss " + evaluation.real_text(trained.best_loss, 6) + " best_val_acc " + evaluation.ratio(trained.best_correct, validation_count) + " correct {trained.best_correct}/{validation_count}",
        "test_loss " + evaluation.real_text(trained.testing.loss, 6) + " test_acc " + evaluation.ratio(correct, count) + " correct {correct}/{count}",
        "top2_acc " + evaluation.ratio(trained.top2, count) + " correct {trained.top2}/{count}",
        "confidence correct {trained.confidence_correct} wrong {trained.confidence_wrong}",
        "forgetting events {trained.forgetting[0]} rows {trained.forgetting[1]} never_learned {trained.forgetting[2]}",
        "weight_norms " + real_words(trained.weight_norms), "weight_changes " + real_words(trained.weight_changes)]
    lines = lines.concat(curve_lines(trained)).concat(confusion_lines(trained)).concat(calibration_lines(trained)).concat(hidden_lines(trained)).append("pruning")
    for item := trained.pruning[]
        lines = lines.append("prune {item.percent} removed {item.removed} correct {item.correct} test_acc " + evaluation.ratio(item.correct, count) + " test_loss " + evaluation.real_text(item.loss, 6))
    lines = lines.append("noise")
    for item := trained.noise_results[]
        lines = lines.append("noise {item.percent} correct {item.correct} test_acc " + evaluation.ratio(item.correct, count))
    ids := [for i := trained.misclassified[] then testing[i].id]
    return lines.append("misclassified {#ids}" + (if #ids > 0 then " " + ids.join(" ") else ""))

int[] ranked_runs(Trained[] runs)
    int[] order := []
    for: index < int(#runs)
        position := int(#order)
        for: i < int(#order)
            previous := order[i]
            if runs[index].testing.correct > runs[previous].testing.correct or (runs[index].testing.correct == runs[previous].testing.correct and runs[index].best_loss < runs[previous].best_loss)
                position = i
                break
        order = order[0:<position].concat([index]).concat(order[position:<int(#order)])
    return order

class Ensembles(int[] majority, int[] soft, int soft_count)

Ensembles ensembles(Trained[] runs, int[] rank, int classes, int test_count)
    int[] soft_runs := []
    for: i < int(#runs)
        last := int(#runs[i].net.layout.levels) - 1
        if runs[i].net.layout.levels[last].activation == "SOFTMAX"
            soft_runs = soft_runs.append(i)
    int[] majority := []
    int[] soft := []
    for: i < test_count
        votes := [for k := (0:<int(classes))[] then 0]
        for trained := runs[]
            votes[trained.testing.outcomes[i].predicted] += 1
        most := 0
        for vote := votes[]
            most = integer_maximum(most, vote)
        for index := rank[]
            int prediction := runs[index].testing.outcomes[i].predicted
            if votes[prediction] == most
                majority = majority.append(prediction)
                break
        if #soft_runs > 0
            real64[] means := []
            for: klass < classes
                real64 total := 0.0
                for index := soft_runs[]
                    total += runs[index].testing.outcomes[i].scores[klass]
                means = means.append(total / real64(#soft_runs))
            soft = soft.append(evaluation.best_two(means)[0])
    return Ensembles(majority, soft, int(#soft_runs))

string[] saliency_lines(Trained top, dataset.Image[] testing, int width, int height, int classes)
    size := width * height
    int[][] maps := []
    for: klass < classes
        real64[] values := [for p := (0:<int(size))[] then 0.0]
        count := 0
        for image := testing[]
            if image.label == klass
                count += 1
                gradient := network.gradient(top.net.layout, top.best_theta, image.vector, image.label, true)
                for: p < size
                    values[p] += absolute(gradient.input_gradient[p])
        real64 largest := 0.0
        if count > 0
            for: p < size
                values[p] /= real64(count)
                largest = maximum(largest, values[p])
        levels := [for p := (0:<int(size))[] then 0]
        if largest > 0.0
            for: p < size
                level := math.floor(10.0 * values[p] / largest)
                levels[p] = minimum(9, level)
        maps = maps.append(levels)
    lines := ["saliency {top.definition.name}", "classes " + words([for k := (0:<int(classes))[] then k])]
    return lines.concat(evaluation.level_maps(maps, width, height))

string[] hardest_examples_lines(Trained top, dataset.Image[] training)
    evaluated := evaluate(top.net, top.best_theta, training)
    int[] order := []
    for: index < int(#training)
        position := int(#order)
        for: i < int(#order)
            if evaluated.outcomes[index].loss > evaluated.outcomes[order[i]].loss
                position = i
                break
        order = order[0:<position].concat([index]).concat(order[position:<int(#order)])
    lines := ["hardest_training_examples {top.definition.name}"]
    for: rank < minimum(5, int(#order))
        index := order[rank]
        outcome := evaluated.outcomes[index]
        lines = lines.append("{training[index].id} label {training[index].label} predicted {outcome.predicted} loss " + evaluation.real_text(outcome.loss, 6))
    return lines

string[] misclassified_examples_lines(Trained top, Trained[] runs, dataset.Image[] testing, dataset.Image[] all_training, int[] majority, int width)
    lines := ["misclassified_examples {top.definition.name}"]
    for index := top.misclassified[]
        image := testing[index]
        Outcome outcome := top.testing.outcomes[index]
        int[] predictions := [for trained := runs[] then trained.testing.outcomes[index].predicted]
        nearest := -1
        distance := 0
        for: i < int(#all_training)
            current := 0
            for: p < int(#image.pixels)
                if image.pixels[p] != all_training[i].pixels[p]
                    current += 1
            if nearest < 0 or current < distance
                nearest = i
                distance = current
        lines = lines.append("{image.id} label {image.label} predicted {outcome.predicted} confidence " + evaluation.real_text(outcome.confidence, 4) + " true_score " + evaluation.real_text(outcome.scores[image.label], 4) + " runs " + words(predictions) + " ensemble {majority[index]}")
        lines = lines.append("nearest {all_training[nearest].id} label {all_training[nearest].label} distance {distance}")
        lines = lines.concat(evaluation.ascii_image(image.pixels, width))
    return lines

string[] comparison_lines(Trained[] runs, dataset.Image[] training, dataset.Image[] all_training, dataset.Image[] testing, dataset.Params params, int width, int height, int classes)
    rank := ranked_runs(runs)
    top := runs[rank[0]]
    count := int(#testing)
    ensemble := ensembles(runs, rank, classes, count)
    lines := ["comparison"]
    for: i < int(#rank)
        trained := runs[rank[i]]
        lines = lines.append("rank {i + 1} {trained.definition.name} correct {trained.testing.correct} test_acc " + evaluation.ratio(trained.testing.correct, count) + " best_val_loss " + evaluation.real_text(trained.best_loss, 6) + " test_loss " + evaluation.real_text(trained.testing.loss, 6) + " best_epoch {trained.best_epoch} epochs {#trained.epochs} updates {trained.updates}")
    lines = lines.append("agreement")
    for first := runs[]
        int[] agreements := []
        for second := runs[]
            agreement := 0
            for: i < count
                if first.testing.outcomes[i].predicted == second.testing.outcomes[i].predicted
                    agreement += 1
            agreements = agreements.append(agreement)
        lines = lines.append(first.definition.name + " " + words(agreements))
    lines = lines.append("mcnemar {top.definition.name}")
    for: 1 <= r < int(#rank)
        alternate := runs[rank[r]]
        b := 0
        c := 0
        for: i < count
            first_correct := top.testing.outcomes[i].predicted == testing[i].label
            second_correct := alternate.testing.outcomes[i].predicted == testing[i].label
            if first_correct and not second_correct
                b += 1
            elif second_correct and not first_correct
                c += 1
        difference := integer_maximum((if b >= c then b - c else c - b) - 1, 0)
        numerator := difference * difference
        denominator := b + c
        chi2 := if denominator > 0 then evaluation.ratio(numerator, denominator) else "0.0000"
        lines = lines.append("vs {alternate.definition.name} b {b} c {c} chi2 {chi2} significant " + yes(numerator * 1000 > 3841 * denominator))
    majority_correct := 0
    fixed := 0
    broken := 0
    soft_correct := 0
    for: i < count
        majority_good := ensemble.majority[i] == testing[i].label
        top_good := top.testing.outcomes[i].predicted == testing[i].label
        if majority_good
            majority_correct += 1
            if not top_good
                fixed += 1
        elif top_good
            broken += 1
        if ensemble.soft_count > 0 and ensemble.soft[i] == testing[i].label
            soft_correct += 1
    lines = lines.append("ensemble correct {majority_correct}/{count} test_acc " + evaluation.ratio(majority_correct, count) + " fixed {fixed} broken {broken}")
    if ensemble.soft_count > 0
        lines = lines.append("soft_ensemble runs {ensemble.soft_count} correct {soft_correct}/{count} test_acc " + evaluation.ratio(soft_correct, count))
    else
        lines = lines.append("soft_ensemble none")
    for: i < int(#params.noise)
        lines = lines.append("noise {params.noise[i]} flipped {runs[0].noise_results[i].flipped}")
    confusion_total := [for i := (0:<int(classes))[] then [for j := (0:<int(classes))[] then 0]]
    for trained := runs[]
        for: y < classes
            for: p < classes
                confusion_total[y][p] += trained.confusion[y][p]
    base := classes * classes
    largest_count := int(#runs) * count
    int[] pair_keys := []
    for: y < classes
        for: p < classes
            if y != p and confusion_total[y][p] > 0
                pair_keys = pair_keys.append((largest_count - confusion_total[y][p]) * base + y * classes + p)
    pair_keys = pair_keys.sorted()
    lines = lines.append("confused_pairs")
    for: i < minimum(5, int(#pair_keys))
        key := pair_keys[i] % base
        y := key / classes
        p := key % classes
        lines = lines.append("{y} as {p} count {confusion_total[y][p]}")
    lines = lines.append("").concat(saliency_lines(top, testing, width, height, classes))
    lines = lines.append("").concat(hardest_examples_lines(top, training))
    return lines.append("").concat(misclassified_examples_lines(top, runs, testing, all_training, ensemble.majority, width))

string[] evaluation_lines(Trained[] runs, dataset.Image[] training, dataset.Image[] validation, dataset.Input data, int classes)
    lines := data_summary_lines(training, validation, data.testing, data.width, data.height, classes).append("")
    for trained := runs[]
        lines = lines.concat(run_evaluation_lines(trained, data.testing, int(#validation))).append("")
    return lines.concat(comparison_lines(runs, training, data.training, data.testing, data.params, data.width, data.height, classes))

void write(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

void run()
    data := dataset.read_inputs()
    validation_count := int(#data.training) / 5
    split := int(#data.training) - validation_count
    dataset.Image[] training := data.training[0:<split]
    dataset.Image[] validation := data.training[split:<int(#data.training)]
    catalog := build_catalog(data)
    checks := gradient_check_lines(catalog, training, data.params)
    Trained[] runs := []
    for definition := data.params.runs[]
        chosen := -1
        for: i < int(#catalog)
            if catalog[i].name == definition.network_name
                chosen = i
        trained := train_run(definition, catalog[chosen], training, validation, data.params)
        prepare_evaluation(&trained, training, data.testing, data.params)
        runs = runs.append(trained)
    last := int(#catalog[0].layout.levels) - 1
    int classes := catalog[0].layout.levels[last].outputs
    write("gradient_check.txt", checks)
    write("training_log.csv", training_log_lines(runs, int(#training), validation_count))
    write("final_weights.txt", final_weight_lines(runs))
    write("predictions.csv", prediction_lines(runs, data.testing))
    write("evaluation.txt", evaluation_lines(runs, training, validation, data, classes))

run()

import layers = "./layers.qui"

class Layer(int inputs, int outputs, string activation, int weight_start, int weight_end, int bias_start, int bias_end)
class Layout(Layer[] levels, bool[] is_weight, int parameters, int weight_count)

Layout layout_for(int inputs, int[] units, string[] activations)
    Layer[] levels := []
    bool[] is_weight := []
    previous := inputs
    index := 0
    weight_count := 0
    for: i < int(#units)
        outputs := units[i]
        weights := outputs * previous
        levels = levels.append(Layer(previous, outputs, activations[i], index, index + weights, index + weights, index + weights + outputs))
        is_weight = is_weight.concat([for p := (0:<int(weights))[] then true]).concat([for p := (0:<int(outputs))[] then false])
        weight_count += weights
        index += weights + outputs
        previous = outputs
    return Layout(levels, is_weight, index, weight_count)

real64[][] layer_weights(real64[] theta, Layer level)
    return [for j := (0:<int(level.outputs))[] then theta[level.weight_start + j * level.inputs:<level.weight_start + (j + 1) * level.inputs]]

class Cache(real64[][] z, real64[][] a, real64[][][] weights, real64[] scores, real64 loss, real64[] output_delta)

Cache forward(Layout layout, real64[] theta, real64[] input, int label)
    activations := [input]
    real64[][] preactivations := []
    real64[][][] all_weights := []
    real64[] scores := []
    real64[] output_delta := []
    real64 loss := 0.0
    for: index < int(#layout.levels)
        level := layout.levels[index]
        weights := layer_weights(theta, level)
        biases := theta[level.bias_start:<level.bias_end]
        all_weights = all_weights.append(weights)
        z := layers.pre_activation(weights, biases, activations[index])
        preactivations = preactivations.append(z)
        if index == int(#layout.levels) - 1
            output := layers.output_scores(level.activation, z, label)
            scores = output.scores
            output_delta = output.delta
            loss = output.loss
            activations = activations.append(scores)
        else
            activations = activations.append([for value := z[] then layers.hidden_activation(level.activation, value)])
    return Cache(preactivations, activations, all_weights, scores, loss, output_delta)

class Gradient(real64[] values, Cache cache, real64[] input_gradient)

Gradient gradient(Layout layout, real64[] theta, real64[] input, int label, include_input := false)
    cache := forward(layout, theta, input, label)
    count := int(#layout.levels)
    real64[][] deltas := [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then []]
    deltas[count - 1] = cache.output_delta
    index := count - 2
    while index >= 0
        propagated := layers.backward_sum(cache.weights[index + 1], deltas[index + 1])
        level := layout.levels[index]
        deltas[index] = [for j := (0:<int(level.outputs))[] then propagated[j] * layers.hidden_derivative(level.activation, cache.z[index][j], cache.a[index + 1][j])]
        index -= 1
    real64[] values := [for p := (0:<int(layout.parameters))[] then 0.0]
    for: i < count
        level := layout.levels[i]
        destination := level.weight_start
        for: j < level.outputs
            for: k < level.inputs
                values[destination] = deltas[i][j] * cache.a[i][k]
                destination += 1
        for: j < level.outputs
            values[level.bias_start + j] = deltas[i][j]
    real64[] input_gradient := if include_input then layers.backward_sum(cache.weights[0], deltas[0]) else []
    return Gradient(values, cache, input_gradient)

class Mean(real64[] values, real64 loss)

Mean average_gradient(Layout layout, real64[] theta, real64[][] inputs, int[] labels)
    real64[] values := [for p := (0:<int(layout.parameters))[] then 0.0]
    real64 loss := 0.0
    for: i < int(#inputs)
        result := gradient(layout, theta, inputs[i], labels[i])
        loss += result.cache.loss
        for: p < layout.parameters
            values[p] += result.values[p]
    count := real64(#inputs)
    return Mean([for value := values[] then value / count], loss / count)

import math

class State(string kind, real64[] extra, int count)
    real64[] momentum := [for p := (0:<int(count))[] then 0.0]
    real64[] first := [for p := (0:<int(count))[] then 0.0]
    real64[] second := [for p := (0:<int(count))[] then 0.0]
    real64 power1 := 1.0
    real64 power2 := 1.0

real64 epoch_rate(real64 initial, int epoch, int step, real64 gamma)
    rate := initial
    for: i < (epoch - 1) / step
        rate *= gamma
    return rate

void update(real64[] &theta, real64[] gradient, State &state, real64 rate)
    if state.kind == "SGD"
        for: p < int(#theta)
            theta[p] -= rate * gradient[p]
    elif state.kind == "MOMENTUM"
        mu := state.extra[0]
        for: p < int(#theta)
            state.momentum[p] = mu * state.momentum[p] + gradient[p]
            theta[p] -= rate * state.momentum[p]
    else
        beta1 := state.extra[0]
        beta2 := state.extra[1]
        epsilon := state.extra[2]
        state.power1 *= beta1
        state.power2 *= beta2
        for: p < int(#theta)
            value := gradient[p]
            state.first[p] = beta1 * state.first[p] + (1.0 - beta1) * value
            state.second[p] = beta2 * state.second[p] + (1.0 - beta2) * value * value
            corrected_first := state.first[p] / (1.0 - state.power1)
            corrected_second := state.second[p] / (1.0 - state.power2)
            root := math.sqrt(corrected_second)
            theta[p] -= rate * corrected_first / (root + epsilon)
